retrievalProfile.description: A nostalgic 1960s album layout featuring a low-angle beach sunset with silhouetted figures and a high-contrast typographic header.
triggerTerms: retro script and bold sans-serif layout
excludeWhen: urban or industrial settings are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A wide-angle, grainy photograph of a beach at dusk where a golden-orange sunset transitions into a deep teal sky. In the lower center, a small silhouette of a couple stands near the water's edge. The top third of the composition is reserved for large, layered typography in yellow and white.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm sunset glow vs. cool teal upper sky
Large-scale header text vs. small-scale subject silhouettes
Fluid script typography vs. rigid block sans-serif
Natural organic clouds vs. geometric text alignment
coreInvariants: Horizontal horizon line in the lower third
Yellow script title placed directly above white sans-serif subtitle
Silhouetted figures against a reflective water surface

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Small silhouetted couple at the bottom center; large typographic block occupying the top 30% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright yellow script title at the top left-to-center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bright yellow script, moves down to the bold white name, then follows the sunset glow down to the silhouetted couple.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive sky and water areas provide breathing room for the dense typography at the top.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Teal and muted blue (upper sky and water shadows)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Golden yellow and orange (sunset horizon and title text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark silhouettes and the bright horizon; saturated yellow against desaturated blue sky.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Elegant formal script paired with heavy italicized sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Script features high-looping ascenders and connected lowercase
Sans-serif is ultra-bold, slanted (italic), and all-caps
Tight letter spacing for the sans-serif block
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase 'H' and 'W' in script have exaggerated flourishes
Sans-serif 'A' and 'R' have thick, uniform stroke widths
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Script over heavy sans-serif creates a 'sophisticated yet powerful' contrast typical of mid-century soul records.
graphicDevices: Rounded rectangular call-out box for secondary info
Stereo indicator in the top corner

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the high-contrast, elegant flourishes of the main title.
Matches the weight and aggressive slant of the artist name.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grainy, 1960s-style film photograph of a beach sunset. The horizon should be low. The sky should transition from a bright golden-orange at the bottom to a deep teal-blue at the top. Include a small silhouette of a couple standing on the shore. Add visible film grain and slight light leaks.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place the main title in a yellow formal script in the top third. Directly beneath it, place the subtitle in a bold, white, italicized sans-serif. Add a small 'STEREO' label in the top left corner and a rounded rectangular box with metadata on the right side.

verificationChecks: Is the horizon line in the lower third?
Is the script text yellow and the sans-serif white?
Does the image have a heavy film grain texture?
Are the figures in the foreground completely silhouetted?

mustRedesign: Avoid using specific artist names or record label logos
Ensure the script is legible despite the flourishes
Maintain the specific teal-to-orange color gradient
postGenerationChecks: Verify typography is left-aligned or slightly staggered
Ensure the grain doesn't obscure the text legibility
Confirm the silhouette is sharp against the water reflection
recipe.reuseFormula: Sunset Beach Photography + Grainy Film Filter + (Yellow Script / White Bold Sans-Serif) Header
